verdict.rationale: The vendor's own pages give only fragments of the memory spec. The product page states ECC support (motherboard-dependent), and DDR5 appears only in generic Ryzen Master and EXPO material rather than as a published spec for this SKU. The 208MB figure is on-chip cache, not system memory, so it does not help size RAM-bound workloads. Missing for 10: a published memory type and speed on the product spec page, a maximum memory capacity, channel count or bandwidth figures, and independent corroboration of the memory specs.
